notes: Godot 4.4+ complete multiplayer spaceship game VertexShip (v0.0.1) by Nalooff, with a vertex-built modular ship editor, main menu, lobby, and combat loop. MIT, Copyright 2026 Nalooff. Fourteen SIL OFL 1.1 fonts from Google Fonts (Aldrich, Audiowide, Black Ops One, Bruno Ace, Electrolize, Jura, Michroma, Orbitron, Oxanium, Rajdhani, Saira Stencil One, Share Tech Mono, Stardos Stencil, Zen Dots); OFL texts bundled under src/assets/fonts/licenses/. No audio files. No third-party art packs; lock.png is a 16x16 original mark, and Hauler/Hull plus docs/img are 1600x900 in-game screenshots. No project icon is bundled (and no Godot default icon). Custom editor addon src/addons/vertex_ships. No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
